# Greedy clique starting from highest degree vertex
def greedy_clique(start):
    clique = [start]
    candidates = set(adj[start])
    while candidates:
        # Pick the candidate with the most connections to remaining candidates
        best = None
        best_score = -1
        for c in candidates:
            score = len(adj[c] & candidates)
            if score > best_score:
                best_score = score
                best = c
        clique.append(best)
        candidates &= adj[best]
    return clique

best_clique = []
for start in sorted(degrees.keys(), key=lambda x: -degrees[x])[:30]:

    if len(clique) > len(best_clique):

def greedy_clique_randomized(order):
    clique = [order[0]]
    candidates = set(adj[order[0]])
